events.title: Loading Improvements and More Languages
events.summary: Hello everyone! Here is what is new in this update: Improved loading for the card collection, talents and combat effects. Added support for German, Russian, French and Brazilian Portuguese. Improved localized text and corrected some translation and text display issues. Thank you for your support! Please share any issues with us through the Steam Community.

events.title: Updates to Our Language Localization
events.summary: We’re thrilled to announce that we’ve added English language support!As a small studio of just four people, we’ve had to rely on AI translation for all non-Chinese languages for now. We sincerely apologize for any imperfections this may cause.
